description: Aerial flora, useful species, and dangerous variants.

entries.title: Aerial Flora of Kaysender
entries.summary: Sky plants survive with little ground by floating, anchoring to cliffs, harvesting cloud moisture, and exploiting magical currents.
body: Aerial flora supports food, medicine, rope, sails, construction, fuel, and trade across Kaysender. Its mobility also makes cultivation unpredictable and allows toxic or invasive species to cross great distances.

Major groups include [[alga-bubbles|Alga Bubbles]], [[sky-wheat-balls|Sky Wheat Balls]], [[bundle-blooms|Bundle Blooms]], [[timber-hearts|Timber Hearts]], [[windweaver-ferns|Windweaver Ferns]], and [[sky-thistle|Sky Thistle]].

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Fauna of the sky / Aerial Flora

entries.title: Alga Bubbles
entries.summary: Buoyant algae spheres provide food, medicine, and low-grade magical energy but release toxic gas when harvested too early.
body: Alga Bubbles drift in moist upper-air clusters. Their inner fluid is nutritious, dried material supports restorative remedies, and exposure to suitable light can release useful energy.
Mature bubbles develop a purplish oily sheen. Premature rupture can release a paralytic gas.

entries.title: Sky Wheat Balls
entries.summary: Rolling airborne masses of resilient grain provide flour, sail fiber, and alchemical ingredients.
body: Sky Wheat Balls resemble cloudlike golden puffballs and can gather into clusters miles across. Their grain produces airy bread, while outer fibers become light construction material and sails.
Storms can break clusters apart and scatter dense seed clouds into travel lanes.

entries.title: Bundle Blooms
entries.summary: Fragrant aerial vines range from healing and structural crops to addictive, invasive, poisonous, and predatory variants.
body: Bundle Blooms anchor to almost any surface and gather moisture through exposed roots. Their flowers support healing preparations and perfume, while durable vines provide rope and building material.
Varieties include healing Celestial Blooms, intoxicating Dreamweavers, invasive Goldenstrangle and Virulent Blooms, floating Driftshade, useful Everbloom hybrids, and deceptive predatory Lurelights.

entries.title: Timber Hearts
entries.summary: Floating woody cores provide rare lumber with species adapted to light, strength, darkness, heat, and living growth.
body: Timber Hearts are airborne woody masses harvested for construction, tools, ships, and magical craft. Their slow growth and mobility make stands valuable strategic resources.
Known varieties include luminous Aurora, dense Ironbark, shadowed Twilight, warm Sundrop, and vigorously living Verdant Timber Hearts.

entries.title: Windweaver Ferns
entries.summary: Air-current ferns yield medicinal, stealth, storm, illumination, and domestic materials depending on variety.
body: Windweaver Ferns orient their fronds to moving air and survive on exposed islands and drifting debris. Silverveil, Shadowlace, Stormtide, Glowglide, and Hearthfern varieties are collected for distinct practical and magical properties.
Harvesters must account for habitat sensitivity and the weather patterns each variety attracts or depends upon.

entries.title: Sky Thistle
entries.summary: A hardy airborne thistle provides useful fibers and remedies while its drifting spines threaten exposed crews and animals.
body: Sky Thistle thrives in harsh winds and poor soils. Its durable material is useful to isolated communities, but mature plants shed sharp airborne seeds that can injure travelers and contaminate grazing areas.
